releaseNotes:
• Native Android Photo Picker & Gallery: Tapping image/photo upload in Instagram, WhatsApp, Discord, ChatGPT now opens your official Photos / Gallery instead of raw file manager
• Smart Media Chooser: Seamlessly choose between Camera ('Take photo'), Gallery/Google Photos, and Files
• Package Visibility Queries: Camera and Gallery apps now fully visible and resolvable on Android 11+
• Official Native System Permissions: Official native Android permission dialogs for Camera, Microphone, and Location
• Bug Fix: Removed restrictive CATEGORY_OPENABLE that was hiding Gallery apps
